evidence.reason: After edit, calls metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "benchmark") and no longer calls metering.initialize(); the test only checks subscriptionCharge(40) > 0, so the effect of removing initialize and changing the plan string is unverified.

After edit, plan is a required parameter and a falsy plan throws Error("context required"); any caller that previously omitted plan or passed undefined would now fail, but no such caller is shown in the supplied usage evidence.

The relationship states subscriptionCharge value-references chargeUnit and chargeUnit value-references usageCharge, but this is an indirect path and does not establish that subscriptionCharge invokes usageCharge or that the plan argument flows between them.

The test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount > 0, but does not cover the "benchmark" plan string, the removed initialize() call, or a missing plan argument to usageCharge.

result.userExplanation: 这两处改动可能让订阅计费路径与用量计费的必填 plan 参数不匹配，但现有证据不足以确认会破坏既有调用方。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 的维护者确认 plan 是否必须为必填；若需保持兼容，应恢复默认值或允许 undefined，并同步检查 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 是否仍需调用 metering.initialize() 以及 "benchmark" 是否为合法 plan。
